name: openpixo/phaser-game-dev
title: Phaser 3 game development craft
description: Write engine-correct Phaser 3 + Vite + TypeScript game code in an OpenPixo game project — scene lifecycle and data passing, loader keys, spritesheets and TexturePacker atlases, Arcade physics, keyboard and gamepad input, registry state, localStorage saves, scaling, Vite public-dir asset paths — and verify with `pixo game verify`.

description_i18n.en: Write engine-correct Phaser 3 + Vite + TypeScript game code in an OpenPixo game project — scene lifecycle and data passing, loader keys, spritesheets and TexturePacker atlases, Arcade physics, keyboard and gamepad input, registry state, localStorage saves, scaling, Vite public-dir asset paths — and verify with `pixo game verify`.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 在 OpenPixo 游戏项目里编写符合规范的 Phaser 3 + Vite + TypeScript 代码：场景生命周期与传参、加载键、精灵表与 TexturePacker 图集、Arcade 物理、键盘与手柄输入、registry 全局状态、localStorage 存档、缩放配置、Vite public 目录资源路径，并用 `pixo game verify` 验证。

examples.title: Separate menu and gameplay
examples.prompt: Split the Phaser sample platformer into Menu and Game scenes. Add Start and Restart actions, preserve its assets and coin rules, and verify restarting five times creates no duplicate listeners.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 把 Phaser 示例平台游戏拆成 Menu 和 Game 场景。加入开始和重开操作，保留素材与金币规则，并验证连续重开五次不会重复注册监听。

examples.title: Add gamepad movement
examples.prompt: Add gamepad movement and jump to the Phaser sample platformer alongside the existing keyboard controls. Apply a stick deadzone, handle disconnection, and verify the TypeScript build.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 在 Phaser 示例平台游戏的现有键盘操作之外加入手柄移动和跳跃。设置摇杆死区，处理断连，并验证 TypeScript 构建。

examples.title: Build a persistent score HUD
examples.prompt: Move the Phaser sample platformer's score display into a parallel HUD scene using registry events. Persist the best score with guarded localStorage access, clean up on shutdown, and run pixo game verify.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 用 registry 事件把 Phaser 示例平台游戏的分数显示移入并行 HUD 场景。通过带错误处理的 localStorage 保存最高分，在场景关闭时清理，并运行 pixo game verify。
